item.title: After years of debate, Texas' private school voucher application opens this week
item.description: As the state's private school voucher program goes live, education experts said it's not just parents with questions about what comes next.

item.title: Kate McKinnon and Daveed Diggs want to bring "hope" for humanity with 'In the Blink of an Eye'
item.description: Kate McKinnon, Daveed Diggs and director Andrew Stanton want their new Hulu movie, "In the Blink of an Eye," to give audiences "hope" for the future.

item.title: New process for heavy trash collection coming to City of Houston, Solid Waste says
item.description: Instead of scheduled collection days, Solid Waste said Houston residents would call 311 to request heavy trash collection.

item.title: Houston on path to overspend $55M on overtime for public safety, solid waste
item.description: Hollins says this overtime problem isn't new, but the latest report shows it's getting worse, and he says if nothing changes, it could start to impact critical services the city provides.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn 'confident' she can race at Olympics with ruptured ACL in left knee
item.description: Lindsey Vonn is "confident" she can compete at the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics beginning this week with a torn ACL from a crash four days ago.

item.title: 'God spared her life': Woman shot by boyfriend survives as Harris County sees a violent 24 hours
item.description: In a 24-hour span, the Harris County Sheriff's Office responded to two separate attempted murder-suicides. In one of those incidents, a 6-year-old child witnessed the violence involving her parents.

item.title: 12-year-old girl kidnapped then assaulted by Dallas man at Galveston hotel, police say
item.description: A Dallas man is behind bars after police say he was found in a Galveston hotel room with a 12-year-old girl who'd been reported missing hours earlier.

item.title: 13 Investigates finds $28M in Houston parking citations are unpaid
item.description: 13 Investigates found one out of every three parking citations goes unpaid in the City of Houston.

item.title: 'Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette' premiere held in NYC
item.description: Ryan Murphy's limited series premieres on FX and Hulu on February 12.

item.title: Cold front pushing thunderstorms away from Houston, chilly sunshine returns Wednesday
item.description: A cold front is pushing toward the Gulf, and after it pushes all the storm away, we'll get a chilly, breezy, and sunny Wednesday.
